summary: Iter 149 — validated the two security/hygiene fixes on the running preview backend. (1) `_get_firebase_app()` now accepts FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (inline env) OR FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH (dev path) and returns None cleanly when neither is set — /api/auth/firebase-session returns 401 for invalid tokens and 422 for missing fields, never 500. (2) /api/auth/google-session now reads EMERGENT_AUTH_BASE_URL from env (default preserved) — with a bogus session_id it returns 401 (not 500), proving the URL substitution didn't break the outbound call. Full auth regression suite green: anonymous, /auth/me, signup (email+verification), login-bad-credentials. Feed/stories regressions from iter148 (dedupe: 19 tests) and iter145 (bot visibility: 13 tests) STILL PASS. Total: 43/43 backend tests PASS. Backend service healthy under supervisor; no crashes at startup. NOTE (report-only, out of scope): FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH in /app/backend/.env still points to the committed key file — the user must complete the manual rotation (rotate on Firebase Console, upload NEW key JSON as FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON in the Emergent secret panel, then delete /app/backend/firebase-service-account.json from repo/disk).
action_items: Manual key rotation (owner-only): rotate Firebase service account on Firebase Console → upload new JSON as FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON env var via Emergent secret panel → delete /app/backend/firebase-service-account.json from disk and remove the FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH line from backend/.env once JSON var is live. Ideally also `git rm --cached backend/firebase-service-account.json` and push to purge from repo history (BFG or filter-repo).
Optional: mirror the same env-override pattern for PUSH_BASE_URL (server.py:3815, hardcoded 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com') so no Emergent URLs live in code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_get_firebase_app (1276-1317): dual-mode credential loading is correct — JSON env is checked first (prod), falls back to path (dev), logs a clear warning and returns None (→ 503) when neither is present. json parse errors are caught and logged (does NOT crash init).

server.py:google_session (1183-1199): _emergent_auth_base is computed once per request from os.environ; rstrip('/') protects against trailing-slash mistakes; default preserves backward compat. Safe change.
server.py:3815 PUSH_BASE_URL still hardcoded — same Emergent hostname category as the one that was flagged for google-session. Consider parametrizing similarly.

.gitignore (93-98): patterns now cover firebase-service-account*.json (any depth) and GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS). Correct. Note that the currently-tracked /app/backend/firebase-service-account.json is still on disk — gitignore does NOT retroactively untrack files, so a `git rm --cached` is required for the fix to be complete on the repo side.
